_comment_top: Manifest for the AIY Plants V1 on-device classifier. While the model.tflite asset is the placeholder committed by PLANTPOTTING-0003 (see the file header), `sha256` reflects the placeholder bytes; regenerate it when the real model is dropped in. All other fields target the real V1/3 FP16 variant.
_comment_thresholds: These mirror PLANTPOTTING-0003 §4.3 verbatim. They are the policy source-of-truth; the Kotlin ModelScoreMapper reads them at construction time, and ModelManifestTest sanity-checks they have not drifted.
_comment_swap_in: When the real V1/3 .tflite is downloaded (~25 MB FP16), update `sha256` to match the new file, set `placeholder` to false, and re-run ModelManifestTest. The real model has 2101 labels; update `label_count` and `output_tensor_shape[1]` accordingly, and replace labels.csv with the upstream label vocabulary.
